_meta.description: The inputs routing.decide saw for each corpus_v1 item of scorecard v2 (DeepSeek V4, 2026-11-08), recovered after the run from each alert's node.completed digests (triage, correlation, analysis) and its final confidence, for the offline policy simulator (lg_sotf.eval.calibration, AI-E1.9). Synthetic corpus; no model output text.
limits: triage.rule_fp, triage.rule_tp: the digest records how many signals triage found, not which; each is listed as 'unrecorded'. No tenant context was configured for the run, so none was known_scanner.
llm_normalized: false for every item (Wazuh alerts, mapped by the Wazuh normalizer).
refused_by: null for every item (the report records 0 refusals).
